task:
UI redesign phase 3 — Finder control polish (plan: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md`, on main, §4 row P3 and "Phase 3 — Finder controls"). START from current `main` (design kit #998, Explore scope/radius A02 #994, viewport streaming #992, Inspect tabs #1002, Plan tabs #1003 are merged; P2a Explore view-state extraction and P5b are open PRs that may merge while you work — do NOT restructure `ExploreWorkspace.svelte` state ownership or the map/layout; keep your edits to presentation wiring so they merge cleanly with P2a, which moves the component-local view state into `explore-view-state.svelte.ts`). apps/web only; no backend, route, request-shape, ordering, cap, anchor-resolution, URL-roundtrip, feature-gate or score-identity change. §7 open decisions 3 and 4 (count exposure, Explore task tabs) are NOT decided — do not add task tabs, do not hide or add any count control, keep all 19 existing count inputs exactly as supported today.

WHAT TO BUILD (presentation and copy only):
1. Finder controls adopt the design kit consistently in `ExploreWorkspace.svelte`, `ArchetypePicker.svelte`, `FinderResultRanking.svelte`, `BodyFilters.svelte` (and their CSS): archetype selection + results stay the prominent primary task; the Body filters pop-out keeps its existing Planets / Stars / Features tabs and Reset / Cancel / Apply; optional sliders live only inside that closable tool; applied/paused chips sit outside it in a `.kit-chip` row with truthful state (applied vs paused when the current mode cannot honour them). Tokens only; no literal colours (`design-kit.test.ts` must pass). The catalogue result card must not be cramped at 1280px width: give the result row a readable layout (name, id64, distance/within text, star class, actions) that works in the current narrow results column without changing which fields are shown.
2. Truthful scope explanations: the existing scope text ("Within 500 LY of X · sorted by distance", galaxy-wide Any-mode wording, the capped-radius hint `#search-radius-capped`, the paused-chip explanation) must read as one consistent sentence family; keep the exact strings that `tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py` and `ExploreWorkspace.test.ts` pin unless you update the pin to the new intentional wording in the same PR.
3. Fix the star-class label: the result row renders `{system.main_star_type} star` (ExploreWorkspace.svelte ~line 2014) but the API value already ends in "Star" (e.g. "G (White-Yellow) Star"), producing "G (White-Yellow) Star star". Render the value as given and only append " star" when the value does not already end in /star$/i (write a small presentation helper with tests; cover a bare class like "G").
4. Plan facility preview: `FacilityPicker.svelte` prints raw evaluation reason codes (e.g. `SLOTS_UNKNOWN`) under "Plan check"; map known codes to the readable labels the plan already uses elsewhere (WhyDrawer/SummaryPane wording), fall back to the raw code only for unknown codes, with tests.
5. Keep: no automatic query on a plain `/explore`, tab switch, draft edit or map close; keyboard operation of every control; focus order; reduced motion; Finder/catalogue star separation on the map.

TESTS: extend `BodyFilters.test.ts`, `body-filters.test.ts`, `search-state.test.ts`, `ranking-state.test.ts` and `ExploreWorkspace.test.ts` for keyboard inputs/tabs, Reset/Cancel/Apply, applied vs paused chips, no speculative weight fields, the star-label helper and the preview reason labels; product `product-journey.cy.ts` keeps archetype choice, anchored Apply/reload, chips after close, axe and reduced motion green (adjust selectors only if markup changed, never loosen assertions). Update plan doc §4 row P3 to "implemented in this PR" and add a dated CHANGES.md entry (`## 2026-11-03 — UI redesign P3: Finder control polish`, newest first — the log uses dated headings, not an Unreleased section).

RULES: pnpm 11.25.0, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` must all pass before you push (run `pnpm format` if needed); run the Python contract tests you touched. Do not touch `frontend/`, backend, sql/, workflows, deploy/ or scripts/. Do not create a flat `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`. No new dependencies. In the PR body list every string pin you changed and why, and confirm the request shapes in `ExploreWorkspace.test.ts` are byte-identical before/after.
